about:
2GIG Engineering, LLC is based in Abbot, Maine, and has been designing and assembling precision tilt sensors since 2015. The privately held company focuses on American-made inclinometers for industrial and commercial motion detection and leveling applications.

The product line spans wired and wireless inclinometers with output options including analog voltage, 4-20 mA, CANBUS, USB, RS232, and Modbus RTU, as well as switching relays and isolated dry-contact relays. Stainless-steel models and polycarbonate mounting accessories are also offered. All devices are designed and assembled in the company's Maine facility, with custom design and tailored solution services available for specialized requirements.

Primary markets include heavy machinery, construction, and renewable energy systems, where the sensors are used for precise angle measurement and leveling in harsh environments. The company also serves broader industrial and commercial customers worldwide.

2GIG emphasizes domestic manufacturing, custom engineering support, and direct customer service as its core differentiators, positioning its sensors as durable, high-precision alternatives for demanding applications.
